info.name: TestPilot API Collection
info.description:
Every API this app talks to, both directions.

- **TestPilot Backend** (5 requests): the app's own Express server (server.js) — Jira proxy, Knowledge Search RAG, and the Ingestion admin panel. Run these against your own running instance ({{baseUrl}}, default http://localhost:8000).
- **Langflow (External)** (6 requests): called directly from the browser (public/app.js) to power the 3 original input modes (typed story / file / Jira) — generation, flow-definition lookup, file upload (2 variants), and conversation history (fetch + delete). Run these against your Langflow instance ({{langflowBaseUrl}}, default http://localhost:7860).

None of these routes require a Postman-side auth helper — auth is either a raw `x-api-key` header (Langflow) or handled server-side and invisible to the client (Jira, Confluence, Mistral, Google credentials all live in TestPilot's own .env, never sent by the browser).

item.name: TestPilot Backend
item.description: server.js — the app's own Express backend. Static file serving aside, this is the complete route list; nothing else is exposed.

variable.description: Any Jira issue key from your configured JIRA_BASE_URL

request.description:
Server-side Jira proxy — the Jira API token lives only in .env and never reaches the browser. Pulls Summary, Description, and (if JIRA_AC_FIELD_ID is set) Acceptance Criteria, converting Atlassian Document Format rich-text fields to plain text.

Errors: 400 (missing ticket ID), 404 (ticket not found), 500 (Jira proxy not configured - missing env vars), 502 (Jira unreachable or auth failed).

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
The 4th input mode's RAG pipeline (LangChain, independent of Langflow) — real hybrid search (BM25 + vector, via EnsembleRetriever) over the Confluence-ingested `test_plans` collection in MongoDB Atlas.

- `source`: only `"testplan"` is currently wired up (`testcases` and `prd` are disabled in the UI dropdown - the Test Cases collection was removed, PRD isn't built as a distinct source yet).
- `query`: required, the question to answer.
- `sessionId`: optional. Omit entirely (or send `""`) for a stateless one-off question. Provide a stable UUID across calls to get history-aware follow-ups - the retriever will reformulate ambiguous follow-up questions using prior turns, and the final answer prompt also sees the conversation history so it can resolve pronouns like "it"/"its".

Errors: 400 (missing query, or unsupported source), 502 (retrieval/generation failed - e.g. LLM quota exceeded).

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Ingestion Wizard Step 2 - lists every intermediate chunk JSON file sitting in src/data/ (newest first), regardless of which source produced it. Not scoped to the current session - shows every file ever fetched.

Errors: 500 (couldn't read the src/data directory).

Ingestion Wizard Step 1 - fetches a Confluence page (Jira Cloud/Confluence credentials come from .env, never sent by the client), converts its storage-format XML to plain text, chunks it, and writes the result to src/data/<slug>-chunks.json (slug derived from sourceName).

- `pageId`: required. Any Confluence page ID - works identically whether it's a root folder or a whole space's homepage (Confluence treats a homepage as an ordinary page).
- `mode`: `"descendants"` (default if omitted - fetches pageId plus its full descendant subtree) or `"single"` (fetches just that one page, no descendants - used for adding/updating one page without touching the rest of an already-ingested source).
- `sourceName`: required. Tags every chunk's metadata.docType AND derives the output filename (slugified) - e.g. "PRD" -> docType "PRD", file src/data/prd-chunks.json. For an existing source, reuse its exact original sourceName to keep tagging consistent.

Errors: 400 (missing pageId/sourceName, or the Confluence API call failed).

Ingestion Wizard Step 3 - embeds a previously-fetched chunks file (Mistral - hardcoded regardless of CHAT_MODEL_PROVIDER, since the corpus must stay in one consistent embedding space) and stores it into the given MongoDB collection.

Idempotent by page: before inserting, deletes any existing chunks sharing a pageId with the incoming file, so re-running (for a full source or a single updated page) always replaces rather than duplicates.

- `fileName`: required. Must be one of the files returned by Ingestion - List Chunk Files (resolved strictly inside src/data/ server-side - a path-traversal attempt is rejected).
- `collectionName` / `indexName`: required. Storing into a brand-new collection/index name always succeeds at the insert level, but vector/BM25 search against a genuinely new index won't work until that index is created in Atlas (a manual step, outside this app).

Errors: 400 (missing fields, invalid fileName, input file not found, or the embed/store call failed - e.g. Mistral rate limit).

item.name: Langflow (External)
item.description: Called directly from the browser (public/app.js), never proxied through TestPilot's own server - these power the 3 original input modes (typed story, attached file, Jira ticket) and the sidebar's conversation history. All require the `x-api-key` header from config.js.

request.description:
The core generation call shared by all 3 Langflow-based input modes (typed story, attached file, Jira ticket) and their follow-ups - only `input_value` and `tweaks` differ per mode:
- Typed story: `input_value` = the story text.
- File mode: `input_value` = "Generate test cases from the attached PRD: <filename>", `tweaks` includes `{ [FILE_COMPONENT_ID]: { path: <uploaded server path> } }`.
- Jira mode: `tweaks` includes `{ [PREFETCHED_STORY_COMPONENT_ID]: { prefetched_story: <ticket fields> } }`.
- Any mode: `tweaks` is merged with `CONFIG.MODEL_TWEAKS` (the model-selector dropdown's current choice) on every call.

Runs Langflow's 2-stage Writer -> Reviewer pipeline (Gemini) server-side within Langflow; can take 30-90+ seconds for the full pipeline.

Used only for auto-discovery: if FILE_COMPONENT_ID or PREFETCHED_STORY_COMPONENT_ID isn't pinned in config.js, the app fetches the full flow definition once and searches its node list by type/ID pattern to find the right component - then caches the result for the rest of the session.

File mode step 1 on modern Langflow versions - uploads the attached PRD file and returns a server-side path, later passed into Langflow - Run Flow's `tweaks` so the File component reads it. Falls back to the legacy endpoint below on 404 (older Langflow).
Fallback used automatically when the modern /api/v2/files upload returns 404 (older self-hosted Langflow versions that predate the v2 files API).

Restores a past conversation's message history from Langflow's own monitor/logging store when a user reopens it from the sidebar (message content itself is never duplicated into TestPilot's own storage - only session metadata is kept in localStorage). Handles both `{ data: [...] }` and plain `[...]` response shapes across Langflow versions.
Best-effort cleanup when a user deletes a conversation from the sidebar - a 404 (older Langflow versions without this endpoint) is treated as success by the app; local history is removed either way.
